_about: Order 264b: quantities that are dimensionless BY NATURE (a ratio, an efficiency, a count). A numeric condition on one of these ("specific gravity below 0.5") is decided against a submitted number with no unit only when the submitted field is NAMED by the same phrase: the whole phrase, never one shared word. A quantity not listed here (a pressure, a temperature, a size) keeps needing a unit. DRAFT: a client discipline engineer approves the list before it is relied on.
